modules.module_title: prepare raw material for Areca leaf craft

pcs.pc_description: collect raw material like areca nut sheaths, cleaning brush/ scrub, sandpaper etc.
collect tools like Scissors, moulding machine and for measuring like marker pen and scale

modules.module_title: prepare Areca leaf for craft making

pcs.pc_description: collect the fallen sheaths from the areca tress
soak the areca nut sheaths in freshwater tank for 2 days approx. to soften the material.
scrub the leaf to stretch little to broaden and to remove the sand particles and dust.
keep the sheaths in the open sun for drying at least for 2 days to remove the moisture from the sheaths.
place an Areca leaf moulding machine at the designated place to make desired craft
control the heat of two pressing heads of the moulding machine by thermostat
place the areca leaf in the moulding machine
set the temperature of moulding machine between 170-180 degree centigrade as to bake the leaf
place the sheath between the hot- pressing heads and press them tightly to give appropriate shape
press against each side to get the desire shape
cut the sheath into a proper shape by the help of cutting blades.
grade the edges of areca leaf plate or bowl, etc. with the help of sandpaper to smoothen the edges
cure the plate or bowl, etc. using UV lights to give a beautiful finish and a clean surface

modules.module_title: Check quality of prepared Areca leaf craft/product

pcs.pc_description: inspect the process based on the quality standard parameters to ensure appropriate quality of sheaths nut craft is achieved.
ensure moulding of areca leaf is done properly
check if soaking and scrubbing process is done appropriately
ensure a proper finish as per requirement
ensure the output delivered is defect free and toxic free.

modules.module_title: Collect required raw materials and tools for making palm leaf craft

pcs.pc_description: collect raw material like palm leaf in a length of 12inches, basin, color powder for dying.
collect tools like cutter/knife, measuring tape, wooden slab etc.

modules.module_title: prepare palm leaf for craft making

pcs.pc_description: collect the fallen dry palm leaf in a length of 12 inches
remove the midrib from the dry leaf and split the palm leaf into two halves
cut the dry palm leaf into more thin strips by the help of cutter/scissors
palm strips are added to the vat of boiled color water and left for the dye to settle on the strips to give respective color.
strips are remove after few minutes and keep for cooling
take dye strips and further weaving process is begin.
arrange the palm strips vertically and horizontally interlocking each other according to the size of basket
place wooden slabs while arranging the strips with hands and feet for support
weave two pairs of palm leaf of an inch’s width and place adjacent to each other with half- centimeter’s gap
keep the two pairs of an adjacent palm leaf in the same position
thin strip is brought over front till the half- centimeter’s gap and insert it is run across horizontally
interlace the sidewalls of the basket and weave till the required length
pass the strips through the small space it is brought on top locking the two pair of palm leafs together, kind of knotting the strips
attach the handles for the basket by measuring from the sides, marking equal spots from both sides
cut the extra palm leaves with the help of small handy knife

modules.module_title: check quality standards of palm leaf craft

pcs.pc_description: demonstrate the inspection process based on the quality standard parameters to ensure appropriate palm basket is being achieved
ensure weaving process is done properly
check if dyeing is done appropriately

modules.module_title: prepare required raw material to make coconut leaf craft

pcs.pc_description: collect raw material like coconut leaf, tape etc.
collect tools like cutter, thread or knife
arrange raw materials carefully for further usage in making appropriate coconut basket

modules.module_title: prepare coconut leaf for craft making

pcs.pc_description: take a long coconut leaf and cut it in a half into two parts
shave the spine thin so it helps to bend or roll it later
cut the small triangle notches on both ends for tying together the rim/ the outer edge
bend the leaf in a circle to help in making the basket
weave the strips of coconut leaves next to each other so that the lines on each strips are face up and from one continuous line to make base of the basket.
take the one strip of the coconut leaf and skip next 3 and weave 4 as over under
pull all the weaving strips out to the outer side/ other side.
make the section of up and down like there is 20 strips and leaving 10 up and 10 down
take the first one down and weave through the last one up and repeat moving down
make sure to do it in an order and tighten them all.
push all the strips to the other side as same as first and weave all the gaps
cut the tips to make the last weave easier
cut off all the extra strips and polish the basket.

modules.module_title: gather and arrange the required raw material for Sal leaf craft

pcs.pc_description: collect raw material like sal leaves, grass stem sticks, corrugate sheets etc.
collect tools like scissors, moulding machine, sewing machine and for stitching like needle and thread

modules.module_title: prepare Sal leaf for craft making

pcs.pc_description: sink all the sal leaf into the water tub to clean and remove the dust.
attach 6or 7leafs with grass stem sticks and make round plates
two such plates are sewn together from sewing machine
put the round stitch leaf plates partly dry in the sun
place the corrugate sheet at the bottom of the same size thread stitch leaf

modules.module_title: preparing Sal leaf plates or bowls

pcs.pc_description: take dry plates and put into a moulding machine
stitch sal leaf gets equal heat and moulding
plates with elevated edges are curve out of stitch sal leaves
press at 120-degree centigrade heat die for 15 seconds to obtain the desire shape
trim thread and loose the ends by the help of scissors
check the moulding plates for the finish

pcs.pc_description: inspect the process based on the quality standard parameters to ensure appropriate quality of sal leaf plates or bowls is achieved.

check moulding of sal leaf is done appropriately
ensure a proper finishing as per requirement
